subject: Sponsor Workshop — Technical brief & demo runbook
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Green <samantha@edgecloud.io>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-14T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Sponsor Workshop — technical brief & demo runbook

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for sponsoring the Redwood + EdgeCloud partner workshop in March. I put together a short technical brief and a proposed run order to align expectations on content and timing (attached: EC-RDW-event-brief-v1.pdf). Key asks:

- Confirm the target audience (edge infra lead vs. dev teams) — we currently recommend a mix but bias to platform engineers.
- Agree on two customer use cases we can showcase (you mentioned CDN offload and cold-start reduction).
- Confirm who from EdgeCloud will be on the panel and who will demo (engineer name + title).

Proposed format (40 minutes total): 10' context + 20' joint demo (Redwood live inferencing + EdgeCloud integration) + 10' live Q&A.

Can you take a look and confirm? If this looks good, I’ll route a draft demo script to the product and marketing leads for slide + runbook edits.

Thanks —
Rishi Malhotra
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Attachments: EC-RDW-event-brief-v1.pdf (pdf, 320KB)

From: Samantha Green <samantha@edgecloud.io>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-14T11:20:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Sponsor Workshop — technical brief & demo runbook

Rishi —

This looks great overall. EdgeCloud is happy with the 40' format. Two quick notes:

- Audience: we'll invite platform engineering and developer advocates (roughly 40 people).
- Use cases: we want to highlight CDN edge-caching with model inference at the edge, and a second microservice cold-start mitigation using a lightweight KV cache you mentioned.

I'll be the primary contact and will bring our lead engineer, Daniel Park (daniel@edgecloud.io). Attaching our sponsor requirements and AV checklist.

Samantha
Director, Partnerships — EdgeCloud Solutions

Subject: Fwd: Sponsor Workshop — technical brief & demo runbook

Folks —

Forwarding Samantha's confirmation and sponsor checklist. Attached is a first-pass demo runbook (internal). High-level asks below:

- Lauren: can you scrub the slide deck (3–4 slides + one flow diagram) for a concise tech narrative? Focus on integration architecture and the customer story.
- Ben: please draft a 12-minute joint demo script that demonstrates the two use cases (edge-caching + cold-start mitigation). We need a clear start/stop points and fallback script.
- Michael: can you review the tech-stack diagram and confirm system calls / config params (I attached tech-stack-diagram.png).
- Tessa: will need your help on speaker prep and time cues—can you own the run-of-show?

I'm aiming to send a polished package back to Samantha by EOD Tuesday (2027-02-17).

Thanks,
Rishi

Attachments: demo-runbook-v1.docx, tech-stack-diagram.png (png, 95KB)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-16T13:00:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Sponsor Workshop — technical brief & demo runbook

Thanks — quick pass from me with inline notes:

- Slide set: reduce to 3 slides — 1) integration diagram (keep but simplify callouts), 2) before/after latency & cost bullet, 3) demo flow checklist.
- Narrative: call out quantifiable outcomes up-front (p50 latency, cost/token reduction by % where we can). If metrics are estimates, mark them as "approx."
- Use case order: start with cold-start mitigation (short, concrete), then deep-dive into CDN edge-caching (longer, more technical).

Ben — please include explicit timings in the script: 0:00–2:00 context, 2:00–7:00 cold-start demo, 7:00–18:00 edge-caching demo, 18:00–25:00 Q&A + buffer.

Michael — note on diagram: ensure we include the KV cache TTL and approximate memory footprint for the demo VM.

I'll take the deck and make a 30-minute edit pass tonight; will upload a cleaned PPT to the Drive link once done.

Lauren Bishop
Sr. Product Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-17T10:17:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Sponsor Workshop — technical brief & demo runbook

Committing demo script v2 — attached. High-level changes per Lauren:

- Added explicit time stamps and speaker cues.
- Cold-start demo now uses a synthetic traffic generator; script includes payload examples and expected logs to show warm vs cold latency.
- Edge-caching demo: step-by-step for proxy config, model variant fallback, and how we surface routing metrics in the Redwood Console.

Please review the doc and call out anything blocking; I flagged a fallback wording under section 3 that might need legal review.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
